facts.value: Command_Execute handles IDs 0 through 9 and returns false for larger IDs. The callbacks clear or advance the cursor, change timer by addition or value minus frame_count, push/pop loop and return state, jump through pointer operands, set timer to F32_MAX, or forward two fields to lbBgFlash_80021C48. No outer scheduling loop or stack-depth validation is implemented here.
facts.rationale: TU synthesis limits the aggregate to direct transitions; external scheduling and shared stack capacity remain family questions.
